counts_for: R1 rounds only; R1 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation, registered only if a round passes on all ten seeds

driver.change: since session 6 (was 86a96079): the stop rule counts this session's train_ended rows whose policy has been evaluated (or that ended with no policy), not the ledger's evaluated rows, so an agent's re-evaluation of an earlier policy no longer uses up a run (session 6 stopped one run early for that reason, record brisk-ember-6734); --max-runs is now per session, and registration.json records runs_ended_before. spec_block.mechanism_rule: byte-identical except the values of HIP_MM and WEIGHT_N, which must equal the evaluated model's rig.hip_height_mm and rig.weight_n as the evaluation report states them (to the block's printed precision); SPEC_LIFT keeps its formula

mechanism.agent_may_change: geometry, bodies, collision shapes and per-body contact settings, joints and limits, actuators, and the parameters that set them, through the ordinary edit and accept path
bounds: four legs on one free base; the spec's feet stay c_foot_fl, c_foot_fr, c_foot_rl, c_foot_rr
the floor body and its plane, and every global physics setting (timestep, gravity, solver), unchanged
actuators stay catalog parts at catalog limits
no contact margin or gap on any shape; cadex evaluate voids every seed of a model that has one (ADR-470)
mechanism.actor_changes: none: the project is as the agent's session-6 turn left it; the prompt states r19's measurements and no product change

warm_start: allowed by the trainer only from a policy on the same model and the same observation/action layout (r19 qualifies while the model and task layout are unchanged); the agent chooses

trainer.rule: ADR-465 and ADR-466, unchanged since session 2

engine.source: the dev tree at c24620bb (src/Mod/cadex, cli/cadex_cli and training/ unchanged since 570a49e7)
engine.rule: nothing under src/Mod/cadex, cli/cadex_cli, training/ or build/ changes while the session runs

driver_args: --max-runs 3 --max-turns 3: per session; the ledger holds 19 train_ended rows before this session, which the driver records as runs_ended_before

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110
per_run.registered_by: train_start writes runs/<run>/registration.json and a train_registered ledger row before launch

wall_clock_bound: 3 turns; at most 3 runs of at most 2400 s each (7,200 s GPU at most); one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or 3 runs of this session have ended and been evaluated (re-evaluations of earlier policies count for nothing), or 3 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py under setsid, outliving the actor's session; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
after: after each evaluation: the spec block is compared under mechanism_rule, contact_offsets must be empty, and the model digest, hip height and weight are recorded; a difference voids that evaluation. If an evaluation passes all ten seeds, a confirmation evaluation is pre-registered and committed before it is run
